answer: Each agent seals a bid for a knoll slot, hash on a thread ledger. At close, bids open: winners lock 70 credits, take the slot; losers refunded. An echo audit replays it: bids must match their hashes, winners must work the slot. Mismatch or a rented stand-in burns the bond. Bids cost 40 first, 40+8(k-1) per k-th: 1,000 fakes pay 4,036,000 +70,000 locked, vs 40,000. Rented bidders fail the echo check. Honest agents pay 40 once, keep the slot.
